# GMEOW Notation and Symbolic Systems Module

The GMEOW Notation and Symbolic Systems Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/notation>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/notation`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Symbolic systems, notation systems, and their usage — the
    representational layer beneath and alongside natural/formal languages.
    Models mathematical notation, musical notation, emoji conventions, gesture
    systems, stenography, cryptographic encodings, and other non-alphabetic
    symbol systems as first-class information objects. A symbolic system is
    NOT a language by default; a standpointed claim may reclassify it
    (Principle 9). Builds on the languages module (#169) and the lexicon
    module (#171).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/notation>
